summary: open <slug> [--obsidian] | edit | new <type> <name> | backlinks | stale | orphans | canvas <hub|#tag> | list
hints: Navigate/grow the wiki: open/edit/new/backlinks/stale/orphans/canvas/list. `open --obsidian` (or PLAINKEEP_OPEN=obsidian) opens the note in Obsidian via a local obsidian:// URI. `canvas <hub|#tag>` writes a deterministic wiki/canvas/<slug>.canvas (JSON Canvas). Common mistake: a duplicate slug on `new` — slugs are unique.

actions.name: open
actions.summary: render a note in the terminal (or Obsidian)

args.name: --obsidian
args.help: open in Obsidian via an obsidian:// URI instead of the terminal

actions.name: new
actions.summary: create a structured note of a given type

args.name: type
args.help: the note type (its template + folder); the `note-type` provider lists the live registry (built-ins + templates/wiki/types.json)

args.name: name
args.help: the note title (slugified for the filename)

actions.name: backlinks
actions.summary: notes that link to this one

actions.name: stale
actions.summary: notes not updated in N+ days

actions.name: orphans
actions.summary: type-note notes with no inbound links

actions.name: canvas
actions.summary: write a JSON Canvas over the wikilink graph around a hub or tag

args.name: target
args.help: a hub note slug, or a #tag (all tagged notes)

args.name: --depth
args.help: hops out from the hub (hub mode only)

args.name: --stdout
args.help: print the canvas JSON instead of writing wiki/canvas/<slug>.canvas

actions.name: list
actions.summary: note counts by type (the default action)
